description: Veriflow Catalog-to-Security Automation Mapping Index. Links production-readiness catalog test IDs to the static scanner rules and live security checks that produce evidence for them. A mapping records which engine covers a catalog case and how completely; it never implies the case is fully automated.

coverage_levels.meaning: An implemented check executes and asserts the intended behaviour, and a fault-detection test proves it fails on a broken fixture.
Some relevant behaviour is checked, but important scenarios for this catalog case remain unverified by Veriflow.
A static pattern suggests the defect may be present. It is evidence to inspect, not a verdict: no taint tracking confirms the value reaches the sink.

static_mappings.name: SQL statement assembled by string interpolation
static_mappings.limitation: Detects spliced SQL text. It cannot prove the interpolated value is attacker-controlled, and a query built across several statements is not matched.

static_mappings.name: Shell command executed through a shell with a constructed string
static_mappings.limitation: Python only. A literal command with no interpolation is still reported, since shell=True is a poor default.

static_mappings.name: Operating-system command executed from an interpolated string
static_mappings.limitation: Python only (os.system, os.popen).

static_mappings.name: Node child process spawned through a shell with an interpolated command
static_mappings.limitation: JavaScript and TypeScript only.

static_mappings.name: Untrusted value evaluated as code
static_mappings.limitation: A sandboxed plugin loader or template engine may evaluate by design.

static_mappings.name: Server-rendered output marked as trusted HTML
static_mappings.limitation: Cannot tell whether the value was sanitised upstream. SEC-LIVE-XSS-001 is the authoritative evidence for a reachable reflection point.

static_mappings.name: Hard-coded credential assigned in source
static_mappings.limitation: Covers named assignments. Placeholders and low-entropy values are filtered, so a real low-entropy password is missed by design.

static_mappings.name: Private key material committed to the repository
static_mappings.limitation: Scans the working tree only. A key removed from HEAD but present in history is not detected; use a history scanner for that.

static_mappings.name: Cloud provider access key identifier in source
static_mappings.limitation: Matches AWS AKIA/ASIA identifiers. Other providers' key shapes are not enumerated.

static_mappings.name: Credentials embedded in a connection URL
static_mappings.limitation: A local development password such as postgres:postgres is reported, which is correct but not an exposure.

static_mappings.name: Credential or token written to a log
static_mappings.limitation: Logging the name of a configuration key, or an already-redacted value, matches without exposing anything.

static_mappings.name: Session or authentication cookie set without security attributes
static_mappings.limitation: Frameworks often apply attributes centrally, so the call site cannot decide the question. SEC-LIVE-COOKIE-001 is authoritative.

static_mappings.name: Host or origin allowlist set to a wildcard
static_mappings.limitation: Covers common Django, Flask-CORS and Express forms. A wildcard set at a reverse proxy or CDN is outside the repository.

static_mappings.name: Filesystem path built from request input without validation
static_mappings.limitation: Reported at LOW confidence: the input may already be validated. Treat as a prompt to inspect, not a defect.

static_mappings.name: Unsafe deserialisation of untrusted data
static_mappings.limitation: Covers pickle, marshal, dill, shelve, unsafe yaml.load, torch.load without weights_only, Ruby Marshal and PHP unserialize.

static_mappings.name: Outbound request to a URL taken from request input
static_mappings.limitation: The URL may be a fixed base with only a validated path segment from input. Veriflow does not probe internal metadata endpoints.

static_mappings.name: Redirect destination taken from request input
static_mappings.limitation: The destination may already be validated. SEC-LIVE-REDIRECT-001 provides runtime evidence.

static_mappings.name: Weak hash used for a credential or signature
static_mappings.limitation: MD5 and SHA-1 are acceptable for cache keys, ETags and content addressing. Purpose must be confirmed by a human.

static_mappings.name: Non-cryptographic randomness used for a security value
static_mappings.limitation: Line-based: a random call and the security variable it feeds must appear on the same line to be matched.

static_mappings.name: TLS certificate verification disabled
static_mappings.limitation: A local test harness against a self-signed fixture is reported; confirm the setting cannot reach a production path.

static_mappings.name: Debug mode enabled in committed configuration
static_mappings.limitation: Cannot tell which settings module a production build loads. A development-only file is a documented false positive.

static_mappings.name: Exception silently swallowed
static_mappings.limitation: A deliberate best-effort path is reported. Those should carry a comment explaining why the failure carries no information.

static_mappings.name: Instruction-shaped text embedded in repository content
static_mappings.limitation: Security documentation and test fixtures legitimately contain these phrases. Detects known phrasings only, not novel injection.

static_mappings.name: Bidirectional or zero-width Unicode in source
static_mappings.limitation: Internationalisation fixtures and emoji use zero-width joiners legitimately. Evidence is printed as <U+202E> so the character is visible.

static_mappings.name: Install-time script execution in a package manifest
static_mappings.limitation: package.json only. Equivalent hooks in other ecosystems are not yet covered.

static_mappings.name: Dependency declared without a pinned version
static_mappings.limitation: requirements*.txt only. Veriflow bundles no vulnerability database: run pip-audit, npm audit or cargo audit for CVE coverage.

live_mappings.name: Security response headers present
live_mappings.preconditions: A running service reachable on a loopback address.
live_mappings.limitation: Strict-Transport-Security is reported NOT_APPLICABLE against a plain-HTTP fixture, since it is only meaningful over TLS.

live_mappings.name: Session cookie security attributes
live_mappings.preconditions: A login path that issues a session cookie for synthetic credentials.
live_mappings.limitation: The Secure attribute is only enforced against an HTTPS target. A bearer-token API sets no cookie and is reported UNKNOWN, not PASS.

live_mappings.name: Reflected input is encoded in output
live_mappings.preconditions: A path that echoes a query parameter into its response.
live_mappings.limitation: Tests one caller-supplied reflection point with an inert probe. It does not crawl, does not execute JavaScript, and does not cover stored or DOM-based XSS.

live_mappings.name: Protected path refuses unauthenticated access
live_mappings.preconditions: A path that must refuse an anonymous request.
live_mappings.limitation: Accepts 401, 403 or a redirect to a login route as correct. Covers the single path supplied, not every protected route.

live_mappings.name: Cross-user resource isolation enforced
live_mappings.preconditions: Two synthetic identities: user A's token and a path to user B's resource.
live_mappings.limitation: Tests one resource pair. Proving isolation across every object type and every role needs project-specific automation.

live_mappings.name: Server errors disclose no internal detail
live_mappings.limitation: Matches 15 known traceback and driver signatures plus 5 secret shapes. A disclosure in an unrecognised format is missed.

live_mappings.name: Public response leaks no credential
live_mappings.limitation: Inspects the single public path supplied. It does not fetch or scan JavaScript bundles, source maps or other linked assets.

live_mappings.name: External redirect destination rejected
live_mappings.preconditions: A path that accepts a redirect destination parameter.
live_mappings.limitation: The probe uses an RFC 2606 .invalid domain and the redirect is deliberately not followed, so no third party is contacted. Protocol-relative and encoded bypasses are not enumerated.

live_mappings.name: State-changing request without CSRF token refused
live_mappings.preconditions: A path whose POST changes state.
live_mappings.limitation: Applies to cookie-authenticated form endpoints. A bearer-token-only API is not exposed to classic CSRF; HTTP 405 is reported NOT_APPLICABLE.

explicitly_not_covered.reason: Veriflow bundles no vulnerability database and will not fetch one during verification. Run pip-audit, npm audit, cargo audit or an equivalent tool and treat its output as the evidence.

explicitly_not_covered.area: Authenticated session lifecycle in a real browser
explicitly_not_covered.reason: Login, session persistence across reload, and logout invalidation are covered by the Playwright browser engine (browser-test-mapping.json), not by the security phase.
Requires executing page JavaScript and persisting state across requests. The security phase issues single stateless requests.
The scanner reads the working tree only. A secret removed from HEAD but present in history needs a dedicated history scanner.
Out of scope by design. Veriflow's probes are inert, non-destructive and loopback-bound. A clean security phase is not a security assessment.
